title: A menos que intervenga la justicia: condicionales excluyentes
goal: Formulate negative exclusive conditional clauses with 'a menos que', 'a no ser que', and 'salvo que' followed by the subjunctive to set exceptions and caveats.
grammar: Condicionales de exclusión con a menos que y salvo que

sections.title: Unit 9: Conditionals I — Lesson 5
body: Welcome to lesson 5 of Unit 9 (Conditionals I: Potential Scenarios). Mastering hypothetical conditionals enables you to explore alternatives, negotiate terms, and calibrate diplomatic courtesy.
In this lesson, we study a menos que intervenga la justicia: condicionales excluyentes, establishing rigorous command of imperfect subjunctive and conditional correlatives.

items: Formulate negative exclusive conditional clauses with 'a menos que', 'a no ser que', and 'salvo que' followed by the subjunctive to set exceptions and caveats.
Incorporate advanced negotiation vocabulary (la salvedad, impeditivo).
